**TL;DR:** On June 17, 2026, Technology and Industrials anchor US sector strength as four of eleven groups achieve "all-green" status, while consumer and defensive sectors continue to lag.

Market breadth is concentrated but robust, with 4 of 11 sectors exhibiting "all-green" performance, remaining positive across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD. Technology (0.929 momentum) and Industrials (0.843 momentum) are leading the market as the sustained strong anchors. Basic Materials (0.814) and Financials (0.614) have rotated into this elite all-green group, cementing a clear cyclical and growth bias in leadership.

Conversely, defensive and consumer sectors are fading. Consumer Defensive sits at the bottom of the momentum rankings with a score of 0.229, closely followed by Consumer Cyclical (0.243) and Communication Services (0.286). Healthcare (0.329) and Utilities (0.386) also remain firmly in the laggard camp, highlighting a pronounced lack of interest in defensive positioning.

* **Cyclical Support:** Basic Materials and Financials round out the all-green cohort, showing synchronized positive performance across all measured timeframes.

## Movers & Momentum

* **Cyclical Momentum:** Industrials (0.843 momentum, YTD rank 3) and Basic Materials (0.814 momentum, YTD rank 4) show strong, coordinated momentum.
* **Consumer Drag:** Consumer Defensive is the primary laggard with a momentum score of 0.229 (YTD rank 6), while Consumer Cyclical trails closely at 0.243 (YTD rank 11).

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Technology hardware, semiconductor supply chains, and industrial metals dominate US equity momentum, supported by healthy market breadth with over a third of all tracked groups in all-green territory.

US industry strength remains highly concentrated in tech infrastructure and cyclical resources. Computer Hardware and Semiconductor Equipment & Materials are leading the market, closely flanked by Copper and Electrical Equipment & Parts. This leadership is supported by robust underlying breadth, with 51 of 144 groups achieving "all-green" status, indicating positive performance across weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and year-to-date intervals.

Conversely, defensive areas, consumer services, and media are fading. Broadcasting, Personal Services, and Pharmaceutical Retailers are severely lagging, pinned to the bottom of the year-to-date rankings. This stark divide highlights a market heavily bifurcated between high-flying AI/infrastructure plays and sluggish consumer-facing or traditional defensive industries.

## Strength
* **Broad-Based Participation:** 51 of 144 industry groups are currently "all-green," showing positive performance across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, and YTD).
* **Tech Infrastructure Dominance:** Computer Hardware (1.00 momentum) and Semiconductor Equipment & Materials (0.99 momentum) lead the all-green cohort.
* **Sustained Cyclical Strength:** Copper, Metal Fabrication, Electronic Components, and Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery are among the top 36 industries demonstrating sustained strength across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top-Tier Leaders:** Computer Hardware (momentum 0.995, YTD rank 1) and Semiconductor Equipment & Materials (momentum 0.989, YTD rank 2) continue to pace the market.
* **Industrial & Distribution Support:** Electrical Equipment & Parts (momentum 0.925, YTD rank 3) and Electronics & Computer Distribution (momentum 0.915, YTD rank 4) show powerful momentum alignment.
* **Severe Laggards:** Broadcasting (momentum 0.082, YTD rank 137) and Pharmaceutical Retailers (momentum 0.125, YTD rank 142) remain anchored at the bottom of the performance spectrum.
